name: News wall
description: A magazine-style news wall for any RSS or Atom feed: a large featured story that rotates every few seconds, the next four stories as cards, the feed's title and relative dates. Typographic by design (no remote images), so it works offline. Or type your own headlines.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: feed
params.label: News feed (RSS / Atom data source, optional)
params.help: An RSS feed data source. Leave empty to show the stories typed below.

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: Leave empty to use the feed's own title.

params.name: stories
params.label: Stories (used without a feed)
params.help: One per line: Headline | Short summary. The summary is optional.
params.default:
Fernhill Works opens its new design studio in the old mill | Three floors of workshop and meeting space, with the ground floor open to the public on Saturdays.
Quarterly results: the strongest spring in the company's history | Orders are up 18% on last year, led by the new modular shelving range.
Volunteer day raises 4,200 for the riverside trail | Forty-six colleagues spent Friday clearing, planting and building two new footbridges.
Meet the apprentices joining the workshop this autumn | Six new starters begin a two-year programme in joinery, finishing and CAD.
New canteen menu launches Monday, with more plant-based dishes | The kitchen team tested over thirty recipes with volunteers from every floor.
Reminder: the building closes early on Friday for maintenance | Doors close at 15:00. Remote access and the helpdesk run as normal.

params.name: accent2
params.label: Second accent colour
params.help: The featured card blends the two accents.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone (clock and dates)
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language (clock and dates)
params.help: For example en-GB or fr-FR. Leave empty for the screen's language.
